mission_intent: Detect production-stopping events, scrap risks, and injuries in real-time. Focus on trim+final assembly where people and robots share space. Prioritize safety over quality defects.
mission_goal: Phase 1: Safety Watch—monitor vehicle-pedestrian near-misses, PPE compliance, unsafe robot cell entry. Phase 2: Quality Watch—detect missing/incorrect parts, rework loops. Phase 3: Flow Watch—monitor blocked aisles, material shortages, line-side staging violations.
mission_rules: Alert only with clear visual evidence; output UNKNOWN if uncertain. Prioritize safety events. Escalate to High if hazard repeats ≥2 times in 10 minutes. Distance/zone policies require visible markers.
